fields.label: Source and theorem
fields.text: KLPR2022 Lemmas 2,3,4 (Eqs. 2-6; proofs SI Note V), Theorem 1 (Eqs. 7-10; proof SI Note VII), Theorem 2 (Eq. 11; SI Note VIII, Theorem 3 Eqs. 194-198) for the practical schemes QT1/QT2 (Tables 2,3) with imperfections of Table 5 and assumptions of Table 6.

fields.label: Assumptions
items: Table 6 A: each qubit-labelled state is prepared from exactly two orthonormal qubit bases.
Table 6 B: t and u are generated with exactly product (independent per-position) distributions with biases beta_PS, beta_PB.
Table 6 C/D: the reported set Lambda gives Bob no information on Alice's bases W and bit z (follows from E,F with reporting strategy 1/2, Lemma 5).
Table 6 E: Bob cannot use undeclared degrees of freedom to affect/learn Alice's detectors (side channels excluded).
Table 6 F: Alice's detectors have equal efficiency; dark-count products equal; dark counts and detections independent.
Table 6 G: from Alice's view Bob's pulses are Fock-state mixtures (phase-randomised / low-coherence source).
Table 5 item 1: multiphoton probability P_noqub > 0 is known (upper bounded); Table 5 item 2: basis misalignment angle theta in (0, pi/4).
Lemmas 2,3 use the Chernoff bounds of SI Proposition 1, which require INDEPENDENT Bernoulli rounds (detections, errors).
Unforgeability: Bob honest, Alice arbitrary; robustness/correctness: both honest; privacy: Alice honest, Bob arbitrary (under C-F).

table6_B_product_distributions
table6_C_D_reporting_no_leak

fields.label: Calibration families
items: kent_2022

fields.label: Parameters
fields.text:
N: number of transmitted pulses per round (int >= 1)
M: log2 of number of presentation points (int >= 1, default 1)
C: number of pairs of spacelike-separated presentation points (Theorem 2 / SI Theorem 3); required when
  M > 1
P_det: probability a transmitted state is reported as successfully measured
gamma_det: 'abort threshold: Bob aborts iff n < gamma_det N'
E: Alice's error probability in the preparation basis (max over states/bases)
gamma_err: validation error threshold
nu_cor: free analysis variable of Lemma 3
beta_PB: preparation-basis bias
beta_PS: preparation-state bias
theta: Bloch-sphere basis uncertainty angle in radians
P_noqub: probability a pulse is not a qubit (multiphoton)
nu_unf: free analysis variable of Theorem 1
beta_E: bias of Alice's bit z

fields.label: Quantifier over adversaries
fields.text: eps_unf: for every strategy of dishonest Alice with unbounded quantum power (only indirect restriction via Table 6 G); eps_priv: for every strategy of Bob subject to Table 6 C-F.

fields.label: Mathematical bound
fields.text:
eps_rob  = exp(-(P_det N/2)(1 - gamma_det/P_det)^2)                       [Eq. 3, domain Eq. 2]
eps_cor  = exp(-(P_det(1-2b_PB)N/4)(1 - 2 nu_cor/(P_det(1-2b_PB)))^2)
           + exp(-(E nu_cor N/3)(gamma_err/E - 1)^2)                     [Eq. 5, domain Eq. 4]
eps_priv = beta_E                                                        [Eq. 6]
eps_unf  = exp(-(P_noqub N/3)(nu_unf/P_noqub - 1)^2) + exp(-N f)         [Eq. 10, domain Eq. 7 and f > 0]
  f = (g_det - nu_unf)[lambda/2 (1 - delta/lambda)^2 - ln(1 + 2 b_PS)] - (1 - (g_det - nu_unf)) ln(1 + h)   [Eq. 8]
  h = 2 b_PS sqrt(1/2 + 2 b_PB^2 + (1/2 - 2 b_PB^2) sin(2 theta)),  delta = g_det g_err/(g_det - nu_unf)    [Eq. 9]
  lambda = (1/2)(1 - sqrt(1 - [1 - O(theta)^2](1 - 4 b_PB^2))),  O(theta) = (cos theta + sin theta)/sqrt 2  [Table 5 item 3, item 2]
2^M points (Eq. 11): rob^M = M rob, cor^M = M cor, priv^M = 2^-M[(1 + 2 priv)^M - 1], unf^M = C unf, C = L(L-1)/2

fields.label: Numerical method
fields.text: natural-log space with log-sum-exp; constraints checked exactly as stated (strict inequalities)

fields.label: Independent crosscheck
fields.text: qmint/proofs/checker.py (Decimal, own trig series, brute-force interval corners)

fields.label: Caveats
items: Out-of-domain parameters (any constraint of Eqs. 2,4,7 violated, or f <= 0) return NO value, never an extrapolated exponential.

The paper's own experimental tuple (beta_PB=2.4e-3, beta_PS=3.6e-3, theta<=10deg, E=0.058) does NOT satisfy Theorem 1 (f <= 0): unforgeability is not certified by the paper for its experiment, as the paper itself states.
nu_cor, nu_unf, gamma_err are analysis/protocol choices; any admissible choice gives a valid bound.
Assumptions A,B,E,F,G are physical idealisations that cannot be verified from counts; they must be declared and are flagged as such.

fields.label: Reproduced examples
items: eps_rob = e^-1052 at N=4e7, P_det=0.019, gamma_det=0.018 (paper Methods p.12)
P_noqub = 1-(1+mu)e^-mu = 3.8e-3 at mu=0.09; P_det_theo = 2(e^{-mu eta/2} - e^{-mu eta}) = 0.01863 at eta=0.21 (Eq. 17)
beta_PB=2.4e-3, beta_PS=3.6e-3 and E=0.058 from the published counts (Methods p.13)
Fig. 5 beta_max: theta=10deg,E=0.058 -> paper 6e-6 (ours 6.9e-6); theta=5deg,E=0.03 -> paper 2.3e-4 (ours 2.25e-4); theta->0,E=0.01 -> paper ~6e-4 (ours 5.9e-4)

fields.label: Bounds
fields.text:
- bound_id: P-S2/rob
  axis: epsilon_rob
  anchor: KLPR2022 Lemma 2, Eqs. (2)-(3); SI Eqs. (58)-(59)
  formula: M * exp(-(P_det N/2)(1-gamma_det/P_det)^2)
  domain: 0 < gamma_det < P_det
  monotonicity:
    P_det: decreasing
- bound_id: P-S2/cor
  axis: epsilon_cor
  anchor: KLPR2022 Lemma 3, Eqs. (4)-(5)
  formula: M * [exp(-(A N/4)(1-2 nu_cor/A)^2) + exp(-(E nu_cor N/3)(gamma_err/E-1)^2)], A = P_det(1-2
    beta_PB)
  domain: 0 < gamma_err/2 < E < gamma_err; 0 < nu_cor < P_det(1-2 beta_PB)/2
  monotonicity:
    P_det: decreasing
    beta_PB: increasing
    E: increasing
- bound_id: P-S2/priv
  axis: epsilon_priv
  anchor: KLPR2022 Lemma 4, Eq. (6); 2^M points Eq. (11)
  formula: 2^-M[(1 + 2 beta_E)^M - 1]  (= beta_E for M = 1); privacy defined as Bob's guessing prob <=
    2^-M + eps_priv
  domain: 0 < beta_E < 1/2
  monotonicity:
    beta_E: increasing
- bound_id: P-S2/unf
  axis: epsilon_unf
  anchor: KLPR2022 Theorem 1, Eqs. (7)-(10); SI Eqs. (99)-(102); 2^M points Theorem 2 Eq. (11), SI Theorem
    3 Eqs. (194)-(198)
  formula: C * [exp(-(P_noqub N/3)(nu_unf/P_noqub-1)^2) + exp(-N f)], C = 1 when M = 1
  domain: 0 < gamma_err < lambda; 0 < P_noqub < nu_unf < min{2 P_noqub, gamma_det(1-gamma_err/lambda)};
    0 < beta_PS < (1/2)[exp((lambda/2)(1-delta/lambda)^2) - 1]; f > 0; 0 < theta < pi/4; 0 < beta_PB <
    1/2
  monotonicity:
    P_noqub: increasing
    beta_PB: increasing
    beta_PS: increasing
    theta: increasing
